data.name: Losing Sanity
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

After the catastrophe at the Red Canyon Outpost research facility, the world as we knew it ceased to exist.

Failed experiments led to the appearance of anomalies, unknown creatures, and unexplained distortions of reality. Cities were abandoned, contact with entire regions was lost, and the last survivors sought refuge within a network of underground bunkers.

Surreal Survival on Wheels

You are an Operator of Bunker-12.

Your mission is to leave the safety of the bunker, explore dangerous territories, gather resources, and make it back alive. Every liter of fuel, every medical supply, and every crate of provisions helps the bunker survive another day.

But the surface is becoming more dangerous.

Anomalies are evolving.

New types of creatures are appearing.

Some can influence the human mind, while others distort the space around them.

The most dangerous ones threaten the entire bunker network.

Main Features

  • Explore abandoned territories and forgotten locations.

  • Gather resources to keep the bunker network alive.

  • Encounter a wide variety of anomalies and creatures.

  • Experience a tense post-apocalyptic horror atmosphere.

  • Complete missions assigned by Command.

  • Operate vehicles and travel beyond safe zones.

  • Uncover the story behind the Red Canyon Outpost disaster.

  • Manage survival while struggling against dwindling resources and your own sanity.

As long as the generators continue to run, humanity still has a chance.

The bunker is waiting for its Operator. He may never return.
